General Dynamics Mission Systems develops high-technology solutions for defense and scientific missions. The Entry Level Software Engineer will design, develop, test, and maintain software for the NOSIS program while contributing to full-stack development, system integration, APIs, containerized deployments, and Agile engineering processes.

Design, develop, test, and maintain software solutions supporting the NOSIS program
Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile development environment
Contribute to full-stack development across frontend, backend, and infrastructure layers
Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and continuous integration/delivery pipelines
Support system integration, RESTful API design, and containerized deployments
Produce and maintain technical documentation
